video_title: Caleb Wilson: My First Media Day

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.text: It kind of feels surreal, you know. But it's here now, so I'm excited for it. You know, training camp starting tomorrow, so it's all just coming at me fast, but I'm really excited to be here and excited to be a Bull. Excited for this year.
quotes.pull_quote: I'm really excited to be here and excited to be a Bull.
quotes.news_angle: Caleb Wilson expresses excitement for his first NBA training camp with the Chicago Bulls.
quotes.social_post: Caleb Wilson is ready for his first NBA training camp with the Chicago Bulls. He says it feels surreal to be here and he is excited to be a Bull.

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.text: In two weeks, I mean, we'll be tipping off and it'll be real. It's my first time getting in an NBA game and playing in the United Center and hopefully I'll be here for a really long time. But I know all the nerves and stuff will go away once the ball gets tipped up in there.
quotes.pull_quote: It's my first time getting in an NBA game and playing in the United Center
quotes.news_angle: Caleb Wilson discusses his anticipation for his first NBA game at the United Center.
quotes.social_post: Caleb Wilson is looking forward to his first NBA game at the United Center in two weeks. He says he knows the nerves will go away once the ball gets tipped up.
